The overnight barrage also targeted four Ukrainian cities and multiple regions, with at least 3 people killed and residential and civilian infrastructure damaged.

Ukrainian Drones Hit Afipsky Refinery for 5th Time, Novoshakhtinsk Plant Reportedly Targeted — Ukrainian drones struck the Afipsky refinery for the fifth time this year, while the Novoshakhtinsk refinery was reportedly targeted in a separate attack. Finland’s Stubb: Deep Strikes Into Russia Are ‘Only Way’ to Push Moscow Toward Peace Talks — Finnish President Alexander Stubb backed Ukraine’s long-range strikes inside Russia, saying they raise the cost of the war and can help push Moscow toward peace negotiations.

What Did the Coalition of the Willing Agree in Kyiv? — Coalition of the Willing leaders meeting in Kyiv pledged stronger air defenses, increased military and energy support, tougher sanctions on Russia and continued preparations for a multinational force that could deploy after a ceasefire.

Armenia Signals Break With Russia-Led CSTO as Kremlin Says Yerevan Is ‘Free to Leave’ — Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan said Yerevan has no plans to return to the Russia-led CSTO and would welcome being expelled from the alliance. Ukraine’s UN Envoy Demands Action Against Russia’s ‘Ballistic Terror’ at Security Council — Ukraine’s UN Ambassador Andriy Melnyk called for decisive international action against Russia’s escalating ballistic missile campaign, saying Moscow is already losing its war and demanding far-reaching sanctions against Russia’s weapons industry.

Rubio Congratulates Ukraine, Pledges Continued US Security and Economic Ties — US Secretary of State Marco Rubio congratulated Ukraine on its 35th Independence Day, reaffirming Washington’s commitment to Ukrainian sovereignty, security and economic ties.

Ukraine Allies Defy Moscow Threats, Pledge Air Defense Boost and Missile Production — Ukraine’s allies gathered in Kyiv on Independence Day with air defense at the top of the agenda, pledging continued military support despite mounting Russian threats. Britain also cleared the release of classified information to support Ukrainian production of Storm Shadow/SCALP missiles.
